title: acer fabri f. rubrocarpum
intro: Acer fabri f. rubrocarpum, commonly known as the Chinese Maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to China. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving circulation, and relieving symptoms of fever and cough. The therapeutic actions of Acer fabri f. rubrocarpum include antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in treating respiratory and cardiovascular conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
